## Presentation at WANDA

**Police Operational Efficiency Using Output-Oriented BCC DEA with Exogenous Crime Workload**

Muhammad Zikriya · Universidade Federal de Pernambuco (UFPE) · GEDAI

This conference presentation examines the operational efficiency of 26 police units using output-oriented BCC DEA, with staff and vehicles as inputs, criminal clear-ups as the desirable output, and crimes as an exogenous workload measure.
